item.name: Night Manta Ray Snorkeling Tour
item.description:
#You will be snorkeling with one of the most graceful creatures in the ocean, manta rays.  

##About
After watching one of Kona’s sunsets on the boat ride to the site you’ll slip into the water after dark, with your guide, and snorkel above majestic manta rays as they somersault below you. This will be an awesome story you’ll tell forever!

**For safety, ALL guests MUST be able to swim 50 yards unassisted, have prior snorkeling experience, and be in good physical and mental health. Kids ages 5+ are welcome if they meet these requirements.**

**Prices vary with demand. Plus tax and fees.**

#Trip Details
- Destination: To see mantas!
- Duration: Early Evening Trip - 2 hours
- In-water snorkeling time: 30-40 minutes
- Suitable for ages 5+ if swimming requirements are met

- 17 & under must be accompanied by a parent/guardian at all times
* You should be in good physical and mental health to participate in this activity.
* This is not a suitable activity for non-swimmers, first-time snorkelers, expectant mothers, those with back or neck issues, or any current injuries or health issues.  You will be denied boarding or entry to the water if we feel it is unsafe for you to participate in the activity and no refund will be offered.

#Things to Bring
- Swimsuit (have it on)
- Towel
- GoPro

#Things Provided
* Mask & Snorkel (we don't use fins on this tour)
* Wetsuit
* Floatation Waist Belt
* Children 14 and under will wear a life jacket while the boat is underway

#Itinerary
* Check-in and equipment fitting
* Boat Safety & Manta Briefing
* 20-25 minute boat ride to site
* Snorkel for 30 minutes
* 20-25 minute boat ride back to the harbor

[Can you navigate getting on the boat from the floating dock?](https://youtube.com/shorts/ZDyZPuKV_pg?feature=share)

#Manta Guarantee

Please note that the Manta Rays are wild animals and we cannot guarantee their presence. If you do not see a manta on your night out, you can go again on another night on a **space available standby basis**.  Keep in mind that standby spaces may be extremely limited, especially during the busiest times of the year.  This offer never expires, but is non-transferable and has no refund or cash value.  We are typically very successful in finding mantas for you; however, if they are not around, the costs involved with setting up the charter and getting all our guests to the location will not allow us to offer you a refund.

##Medical and Health

Your health is important to us.  Kindly read the medical questionnaire listed below.  You acknowledge your responsibility for any omissions related to the failure to disclose any present or previous health conditions. If you have a positive response you will seek approval from a physician prior to joining a tour with Splashers Ocean Adventures, Inc DBA Kona Snorkel Trips.

[Medical Questionnaire](https://www.padi.com/sites/default/files/documents/2020-08/10346E_Diver_Medical_Form.pdf)

Please be aware of severe health risks - this can be a stress-inducing activity and is not recommended for those with heart conditions, high blood pressure, or those who have severe asthma.

*Upload your favorite photos to us on social media.  Instagram hashtag #konasnorkeltrips and @konasnorkeltrips on IG & Facebook.*

Visit our extensive [FAQ's](https://konasnorkeltrips.com/faq/) to find the answers to any questions.

*Minimum of six guests for the charter to run*
item.booking_notes:
Aloha! (This is an automated email)

We’re excited to take you on an unforgettable manta ray night snorkel! Before you embark on this adventure, please review these important details carefully.

#First Things First…
✅ Are you booked for the correct date? Booked for the correct island? Double-check your reservation to avoid any mix-ups. If you booked the wrong date and do not contact us more than 48 hours before the trip, no rebooking or refund will be offered.
##✅ **Complete Your Digital Waiver**
This must be completed before arrival for check-in. This is a **required** step to make it from the reservation to the Captain's manifest. If waivers are not done two hours before arrival, you run the risk of forfeiting your reservation.
##Trip Details
📍 Destination: To see mantas!
⏳ Duration: 2 hours
👥 Minimum of six guests required for the tour to operate

##Important Tips for Your Trip
Be on Time and have waivers signed! ⏰
🚨 **Arrive 15 minutes before the posted tour time for check-in.** If you arrive later than your scheduled tour time, you will be considered a NO SHOW and won’t be able to receive a refund OR reschedule your tour. We want you to join us, but we respect our other guests' time.
🚨 NO SHOWS to the trip won’t be able to receive a refund OR reschedule your tour. 
🚨 Bringing kids?  Prepare your children by showing them a video of what to expect.
🚨Please follow the directions provided in this confirmation email carefully. You're in the wrong spot if your location doesn’t match the photo above! Use the directions link!
✨If you are booked on the second or third manta trip, our vessel will be returning from a previous charter. Once the vessel is secure and guests have departed, we will assist you with check-in and boarding. Thank you for your patience and for giving us room as we transition between trips. 

##Storage Space is Limited 🚤
🔹 The Orca is a wet boat - expect some seaspray! You’ll wear your wetsuit partially on during the ride.
🔹 Leave most of your belongings on land. If necessary, bring a small dry bag for essentials.

##Come Dressed & Ready to Snorkel
✔️ Wear your swimsuit before arrival - we won’t have time to wait for you to change.

##Seasickness Prevention
🌊 While most guests don’t experience seasickness, ocean conditions can vary. Consider taking motion sickness medication in advance. Seabands are available for purchase at check-in.

##Bring Your Sense of Adventure! 🚀
This is a retired Navy SEAL boat, not a slow cruise! Be ready for an exhilarating ride!

📌 [Check out our FAQ for more details!](https://konasnorkeltrips.com/faq/) 

##Health & Safety Requirements
Your safety is our top priority. Everyone in your party must be in good physical and mental health.

🚫 This tour is NOT suitable for:

* Pregnant women (due to the vessel’s adventurous nature).
* The elderly 
* Those with limited mobility - you must be able to board the boat independently.
* Anyone with **heart conditions, high blood pressure, severe asthma, etc** - this can be a physically demanding activity.

🚨If you've listed that you carry medication (i.e., inhaler) in your reservation, **BRING THEM**; otherwise, you will not be permitted to board and will be marked as a no-show, and no refund will be available. This stems from our experience and our care for your safety.

**If we determine that it is unsafe for you to participate, you will be denied boarding or entry into the water.**

**Basic swimming and snorkeling skills are required; we cannot provide one-on-one instruction during the group tour.**

**Kids under 18 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian at all times - on the boat and in the water.**

##What to Bring
✔️ Towel
📷 GoPro or waterproof camera
##Waterproof phone cases with long lanyards are not permitted. These items interfere with manta rays and may cause them to leave the area.

##What We Provide
Mask & Snorkel (No fins used on this tour)
Shortie Wetsuit
Flotation Waist Belt
Life jackets for children 14 & under while the boat is underway

🚨Full face masks are not permitted on any of our trips due to safety concerns.

##Itinerary
📍 Check-in & equipment fitting
📖 Boat safety & manta briefing
⏳ 20-25 min boat ride to the site
🤿 30 min snorkeling session
⏳ 20-25 min boat ride back to the harbor

##Manta Guarantee 🌙🐠
Manta rays are wild animals, and while we have great success finding them, sightings are not guaranteed. If you don’t see a manta during your trip, you may join another tour on a space-available, standby basis.  **THERE IS NO REFUND IF WILDLIFE DOES NOT APPEAR**

🔹 Important: This offer never expires, but it is non-transferable and has no cash value. Standby spaces are extremely limited, especially during peak seasons.

While the manta rays occasionally take a break, our boats, crew, and operating expenses don’t! Because of this, we’re unable to offer refunds for tours where manta rays aren’t seen. This policy is standard across all manta ray snorkel operators in Kona. 

##Rescheduling & Rebooking
🔄 Both Non-Refundable & Refundable Tickets:

Outside 48 hours: You can reschedule or rebook by clicking “**Change Booking**” in this email (under the date of your activity).

Within 48 hours: Changes are not possible.

##Additional Info

📧 International Guests: We can only contact you via the email you provided. Please check it regularly for important trip updates.

📲 We may also send important details via text about ocean conditions or cancellation info.

🚨We do not recommend relying on Uber and Lyft for transportation

📸 Share Your Experience! Tag us on Instagram @konasnorkeltrips and use #konasnorkeltrips - we’d love to see your photos!

💰 Tipping is customary in this industry. If you had an amazing time, bring cash or use Venmo to show your appreciation to the crew!

🌴 Looking for more island adventures? Check out [Other Island Activities here](https://konasnorkeltrips.com/other-island-activities/)

We can’t wait to take you on this once-in-a-lifetime experience! See you soon!

Mahalo,
KST Crew
item.cancellation_notes:
We commit to our employees and other guests and adhere to our cancellation policy regardless of circumstances.  ***We recommend travel insurance or a premium credit card with trip protection to cover unexpected disruptions such as illness, injury, severe weather, or airline/travel disruption. etc.***


**Refundable Ticket:**
Cancellation: Full refund if canceled up to 48 hours before the trip.
Rebooking: Free rebooking up to 48 hours before the trip.

**All cancellation requests must be submitted in writing at least 48 hours before the trip's start. Reservations made within 48 hours are not eligible for a refund.**

**Non-Refundable Ticket:**
Cancellation: No refunds. All Sales are Final.
Rebooking: Rebooking is allowed up to 48 hours before the trip.

###Flexible Cancellation Upgrade for Refundable Tickets
If you purchased the upgrade, your cancellation window is extended to up to **12 hours** before the start of the trip. You’ll be fully refunded for the ticket (**minus the upgrade and fees**). 

###No-shows and Late Arrivals will not be refunded or rescheduled.

###What if we cancel?

We reserve the right to cancel for any reason, including but not limited to weather, ocean conditions, passenger count, mechanical issues, or safety concerns for you, our guests, and our crew. We’ll do our best to reschedule your trip based on availability, or you’ll be issued a refund in full.

###Double-Check Your Dates Before Completing Your Booking!
If you booked the wrong date and do not contact us more than 48 hours in Advance of the trip, no rebooking or refund will be offered.

###Contact Information
International guests: we can only contact you by the email you've provided or via text in our reservation system. Please check your email regularly, as we may need to send you important information about your trip. ALL GUESTS: We are not responsible if we cannot contact you through the information you've provided regarding important information about the trip.  

###Identification
***The name on your credit card must match the contact name on your booking.*** *For your security, at check-in, you may be required to present the credit card that was used to pay for your booking, along with a matching valid photo ID

There is free parking available in the parking lot.  If you end up at the boat ramps, you are on the WRONG SIDE of the harbor
